answer_1.quote: We evaluate self-correction capability on both classification and generation tasks, including domains in mathematics, coding, instruction following, common-sense reasoning, and knowledge.
answer_1.outputs: Generated answers to questions (e.g., math solutions, code snippets, instruction-following responses)

answer_2.quote: Self-correction capability evaluation experiments are conducted on various models and Accuracy (%) before and after self-correction is reported. We also report Confidence Level and Critique Score, and use Relative Self-Correction Score (RSS) for overall assessment.
